about: The Passion of Our Lord according to Saint Matthew in the Palm Sunday formulary of the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: At that time Jesus came with His disciples into a country place which is called Gethsemani, and He said to His disciples:

s02.translation: Sit here while I go over there and pray.

s03.translation: And taking with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, He began to grow sorrowful and to be sad. Then He says to them:

s04.translation: My soul is sorrowful even to death; stay here and watch with Me.

s05.translation: And going a little farther, He fell upon His face, praying and saying:

s06.translation: My Father, if it is possible, let this chalice pass from Me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as You will.

s07.translation: And He comes to His disciples and finds them asleep, and He says to Peter:

s08.translation: What, could you not watch one hour with Me? Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

s09.translation: Again, a second time, He went away and prayed, saying:

s10.translation: My Father, if this chalice cannot pass away unless I drink it, Your will be done.

s11.translation: And He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy. And leaving them, He went away again and prayed a third time, saying the same words. Then He comes to His disciples and says to them:

s12.translation: Sleep now and take your rest. Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man will be betrayed into the hands of sinners. Rise, let us go; behold, he who will betray Me is at hand.

s13.translation: While He was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the Twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people. And he who betrayed Him gave them a sign, saying:

s14.translation: Whomever I kiss, that is He; hold Him fast.

s15.translation: And at once coming up to Jesus, he said:

s17.translation: And he kissed Him. And Jesus said to him:

s18.translation: Friend, what have you come for?

s19.translation: Then they came up and laid hands on Jesus and held Him. And behold, one of those who were with Jesus, stretching out his hand, drew his sword, and striking the servant of the high priest, cut off his ear. Then Jesus says to him:

s20.translation: Put your sword back into its place, for all who take the sword will perish by the sword. Do you think that I cannot ask My Father, and He will give Me at once more than twelve legions of angels? How then will the Scriptures be fulfilled, that it must be so?

s21.translation: In that same hour Jesus said to the multitudes:

s22.translation: You have come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs, to apprehend Me. Daily I sat with you teaching in the temple, and you did not lay hands on Me.

alignments.gloss: you did not lay hands on Me

s23.translation: Now all this was done that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples, leaving Him, fled. But they, holding Jesus, led Him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had assembled. And Peter followed Him at a distance, as far as the courtyard of the high priest; and going in, he sat with the servants to see the end. And the chief priests and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put Him to death, and they found none, though many false witnesses had come forward. At last two false witnesses came, and they said:

alignments.gloss: they might put Him to death

s24.translation: This man said: I am able to destroy the temple of God, and after three days to rebuild it.

s25.translation: And the high priest, rising up, said to Him:

s26.translation: Do You answer nothing to the things which these witness against You?

s27.translation: But Jesus kept silent. And the high priest said to Him:

s28.translation: I adjure You by the living God, that You tell us whether You are the Christ, the Son of God.

s30.translation: You have said it. Nevertheless I say to you, hereafter you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the power of God, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

s31.translation: Then the high priest tore his garments, saying:

s32.translation: He has blasphemed. What further need have we of witnesses? Behold, now you have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?

s35.translation: Then they spat in His face and struck Him with their fists, and others struck His face with the palms of their hands, saying:

s36.translation: Prophesy to us, O Christ: who is it that struck You?

s37.translation: But Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard, and a maidservant came to him, saying:

s38.translation: You too were with Jesus the Galilean.

s39.translation: But he denied it before them all, saying:

s40.translation: I do not know what you are saying.

s41.translation: And as he went out of the gate, another maidservant saw him, and she says to those who were there:

s42.translation: This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.

s43.translation: And again he denied it with an oath: I do not know the man. And after a little while those who stood by came up and said to Peter:

s44.translation: Surely you too are one of them, for even your speech betrays you.

s45.translation: Then he began to curse and to swear that he did not know the man. And immediately the cock crowed. And Peter remembered the word of Jesus which He had said: Before the cock crows, you will deny Me three times. And going out, he wept bitterly. And when morning had come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus, to put Him to death. And they brought Him bound and delivered Him to Pontius Pilate the governor. Then Judas, who betrayed Him, seeing that He was condemned, repenting, brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders, saying:

alignments.gloss: they might put Him to death

s46.translation: I have sinned in betraying righteous blood.

s48.translation: What is that to us? See to it yourself.

s49.translation: And casting down the pieces of silver in the temple, he departed, and went and hanged himself with a noose. But the chief priests, having taken the pieces of silver, said:

s50.translation: It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

alignments.gloss: it is the price of blood

s51.translation: And after they had taken counsel, they bought with them the potter’s field, as a burial place for strangers. For this reason that field has been called Haceldama, that is, the field of blood, to this day. Then was fulfilled what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying: And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of Him who was priced, whom some of the children of Israel valued, and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed to me. And Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked Him, saying:

alignments.gloss: whom some of the children of Israel valued

s52.translation: Are You the King of the Jews?

s55.translation: And when He was accused by the chief priests and elders, He answered nothing. Then Pilate says to Him:

s56.translation: Do You not hear how many testimonies they bring against You?

alignments.gloss: how much testimony they give against You

s57.translation: And He did not answer him a single word, so that the governor wondered exceedingly. Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the people one prisoner, whomever they wished. And he had then a notorious prisoner, who was called Barabbas. So when they had gathered, Pilate said:

s58.translation: Whom do you want me to release to you, Barabbas or Jesus, who is called Christ?

s59.translation: For he knew that out of envy they had delivered Him up. And as he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying:

s60.translation: Have nothing to do with that just man, for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of Him.

s61.translation: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the people to ask for Barabbas and to destroy Jesus. And the governor answered and said to them:

s62.translation: Which of the two do you want released to you?

alignments.gloss: Which of the two do you want to be released to you

s66.translation: What then shall I do with Jesus, who is called Christ?

s70.translation: Why, what evil has He done?

s71.translation: But they cried out the more, saying:

s73.translation: And Pilate, seeing that he was achieving nothing, but rather that a tumult was arising, took water and washed his hands before the people, saying:

s74.translation: I am innocent of the blood of this just man; see to it yourselves.

s75.translation: And the whole people answered and said:

s76.translation: His blood be upon us and upon our children.

s77.translation: Then he released Barabbas to them, and having scourged Jesus, delivered Him to them to be crucified. Then the soldiers of the governor, taking Jesus into the praetorium, gathered the whole cohort around Him. And stripping Him, they put a scarlet cloak about Him, and plaiting a crown of thorns, they put it upon His head, and a reed in His right hand. And bowing the knee before Him, they mocked Him, saying:

alignments.gloss: they put a scarlet cloak around

s79.translation: And spitting upon Him, they took the reed and struck His head. And after they had mocked Him, they took the cloak off Him, put His own garments on Him, and led Him away to crucify Him. And going out, they found a man of Cyrene named Simon; him they forced to take up His cross. And they came to the place called Golgotha, which is the place of Calvary. And they gave Him wine mingled with gall to drink; and when He had tasted it, He would not drink. And after they had crucified Him, they divided His garments, casting lots, so that the words spoken by the prophet might be fulfilled: They divided My garments among them, and upon My vesture they cast lots. And sitting down, they kept watch over Him. And they put over His head the charge against Him, written: This is Jesus, the King of the Jews. Then two thieves were crucified with Him, one on the right and one on the left. And those who passed by blasphemed Him, wagging their heads and saying:

s80.translation: Vah, You who destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself. If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross.

s81.translation: In like manner also the chief priests, with the scribes and elders, mocking, said:

s82.translation: He saved others; Himself He cannot save. If He is the King of Israel, let Him now come down from the cross, and we will believe Him. He trusts in God; let Him now deliver Him, if He wants Him, for He said: I am the Son of God.

s83.translation: And the thieves also, who were crucified with Him, reproached Him with the same thing. Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over the whole earth until the ninth hour. And about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying:

s86.translation: My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?

s87.translation: And some who stood there and heard it said:

s89.translation: And immediately one of them ran, took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed and gave Him to drink. But the others said:

s90.translation: Wait, let us see whether Elijah will come to deliver Him.

s91.translation: And Jesus, again crying out with a loud voice, yielded up His spirit.

s92.narrative: Here all genuflect and pause for a short while.

s93.translation: And behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom, and the earth quaked, and the rocks were split, and the tombs were opened; and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep arose. And coming out of the tombs after His resurrection, they came into the holy city and appeared to many. Now the centurion and those who were with him keeping watch over Jesus, having seen the earthquake and the things that were happening, were greatly afraid, saying:

s94.translation: Truly this was the Son of God.

s95.translation: And many women were there at a distance, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to Him; among them were Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee. And when it was evening, there came a certain rich man of Arimathea, named Joseph, who himself also was a disciple of Jesus. He went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate ordered the body to be given up. And Joseph, taking the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock. And he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb and went away.

alignments.gloss: the mother of James and Joseph
commanded the body to be delivered

w599.explanation: Novi is a perfect form with present meaning here: Peter denies knowing Jesus.

w630.explanation: Novisset is a pluperfect subjunctive form. Here it reports Peter’s claim that he did not know Jesus.
